title: Phenomenal, bodily and brain correlates of fictional reappraisal as an implicit emotion regulation strategy
authors: Makowski, D., Sperduti, M., Pelletier, J., Blondé, P., La Corte, V., Arcangeli, M., Zalla, T., Lemaire, S., Dokic, J., Nicolas, S., & Piolino, P.
summary: The same images, presented as real photographs or as staged fiction, measured at three levels at once: what people reported feeling, what their bodies did, and what their brains did. The paper reports the correlates of fictional reappraisal at each level, and treats it as an emotion-regulation strategy nobody has to choose to use.
